basic_details.job_title: DSVCKV Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The DSVCKV Recruitment 2026 walk-in interview for Teaching Associates will be held on 29 October 2026 at the Office of the Dean, College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Anjora, Durg. The Office of the Dean, College of Vety. Science & A.H. Anjora, Durg, under Dau Shri Vasudev Chandrakar Kamdhenu Vishwavidyalaya, is filling 10 Teaching Associate posts in nine departments: 8 at the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Anjora, Durg and 2 at the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Bilaspur. The monthly honorarium is Rs. 62,800/- for Ph.D. degree holders and Rs. 57,700/- for Master's degree holders

content_sections.heading: About DSVCKV
content_sections.text: Dau Shri Vasudev Chandrakar Kamdhenu Vishwavidyalaya (DSVCKV) is a university based in Durg, Chhattisgarh. The College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Anjora, Durg and the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Bilaspur are two of its colleges. This walk-in notice was issued by the Office of the Dean of the Anjora college, and it covers Teaching Associate posts at both colleges.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists the Teaching Associate vacancies by department and by college. The printed totals are 08 posts at Anjora, Durg and 02 at Bilaspur, which makes 10 in all. The notice gives one qualification for the Teaching Associate post in every department: A. Candidate with minimum Master's Degree in concerned subject with NET or Ph.D. Degree in the same/relevant subject. OR B. Candidate with minimum Master's Degree in concerned subject without NET in the same/relevant subject. Non-NET candidates will only be considered if NET candidates are not available for selection as Teaching Associate. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification. The maximum age limit for Teaching Associates is the limit that the State Government fixes for direct recruitment. Reservation follows the rules of the Government of Chhattisgarh. Teaching Associates get only the fixed honorarium. No other allowances will be paid. A Teaching Associate may also be given examination duty, but no separate honorarium will be paid for it. The working period of a Teaching Associate will be a maximum of 01 year. A candidate selected as Teaching Associate will be entitled to 10 paid casual leave. A selected candidate cannot claim regularisation in any form. They will also get no priority or relaxation for that post at the time of regular recruitment. The service of a Teaching Associate may be ended at any time on one month's prior notice, without a reason being given. A Teaching Associate may also resign by giving one month's prior notice. All the rules for Teaching Associates in V.V. DSVCKV notification No.Estt./2024/1193 Durg Dated 20.09.2024 will apply to the selected candidates.

content_sections.heading: DSVCKV Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the following work, and it applies to Teaching Associates in all the departments: Teaching work in the college. Academic and office work, and other work such as examinations, cultural activities and sports, in addition to teaching. Examination duty, with no separate honorarium. Conducting examinations in their related subjects as internal examiners, with the appointed external examiners present.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring the following to the interview on 29 October 2026: Original 10th mark sheet Original 12th mark sheet Original BVSc & A.H. mark sheets Original M.V.Sc. mark sheets Original Ph.D. mark sheets NET certificate Any other relevant documents (the notice says "etc.") One set of photocopies of these documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining duty. Reservation will apply as per the rules of the Government of Chhattisgarh. Check the website dsvckvdurg.ac.in for any further notice or information about this recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the DSVCKV Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 29 October 2026 at the Office of the Dean College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Anjora, Durg.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DSVCKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 Teaching Associate vacancies: 08 at the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Anjora, Durg and 02 at the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Bilaspur, spread over nine departments.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DSVCKV Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum Master's Degree in the concerned subject with NET or a Ph.D. Degree in the same/relevant subject. Candidates with a minimum Master's Degree in the concerned subject without NET can also attend.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DSVCKV Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is the limit that the State Government fixes for direct recruitment. Reservation follows the rules of the Government of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a DSVCKV Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs. 62,800/- for a Ph.D. degree holder and Rs. 57,700/- for a Master's degree holder. No other allowances are paid on top of this fixed honorarium.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the originals of your 10th, 12th, BVSc & A.H., M.V.Sc. and Ph.D. mark sheets, your NET certificate and other relevant documents, with one set of photocopies.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DSVCKV Teaching Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The working period is a maximum of 01 year, and the selected candidate cannot claim regularisation. The service may be ended on one month's notice.

faq.question: Q8. Will DSVCKV pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining duty.

faq.question: Q9. How much leave does a DSVCKV Teaching Associate get?
faq.answer: A candidate selected as Teaching Associate is entitled to 10 paid casual leave.
